activities.assay_description: Competitive Binding Assay: Competitive binding assays were performed by incubating rhER alpha (α) and beta 1 (β1) receptors with 10 nM [3H]estradiol (the radio ligand) in the presence or absence of increasing concentrations, 0.25 to 250,000 nM, of the phenolic test compounds of Tables 1 to 3 (nM is nano molar). Each data point is the average of at least two assays. Stock solutions of the compounds of Tables 1 to 3 were prepared at 10×E-2 M in 100% ethanol, water or DMSO (dimethyl sulfoxide). Compounds were diluted 10 fold in binding buffer and then 1:4 in the final assay mix. The final concentration of ethanol or DMSO in the assay well was 5%. The highest concentration of the hydrolysis test compound was 2.5×E-4 M (250,000 nM). The residual monomers of Tables 1 to 3 were tested at seven concentrations over log increments. The lowest concentration was 2.5×E-10 M (0.25 nM).
